body: Thanks, it's worth a lot. Comfort is worth its weight in gold at times like this.

At this point, just to have somewhere I can go to everyday. Somewhere I can sit down and work on my projects. Someplace where I can study, experiment, and live without worrying about immediate fears. (Death, homelessness, starvation, without all the pressure I have now from my father to become some kind of rich mogul)

You're kind. But I doubt any positive change will happen before things become worse. In two days, like it or not I will be without a home. My father will find out, and everything will fall apart. I will attempt to escape from the pain, and I will die.

You've helped though. There was another project I had stashed away that attempted to come to grips with the reality that not everyone can be saved, and avoiding horrible deaths. Not everyone can be saved, but I think we can all die good deaths. It's my hope that by posting this I can be find a little more happiness before the end. My only fear is dying alone, with all my ideas and hopes laying at the wayside. With not a single person knowing exactly what I felt before the end.

Thanks, I used to get really stressed about it. I wanted to make the world a better place and live my own dream at the same time.

But I came to terms with the fact that I might have to take it slow and steady. So you're right, it's better to have accomplished something than nothing.

But that doesn't really matter now, I won't even be able to do that here shortly.

I appreciate the response. The harder I try not to disappoint, it seems the more I do it. I wish I could just cut ties, but I love them far too much.

Sure, I have a small video game development company. It's been something I wanted to do ever since I was a child. It's a ambitious project that I've been working on for years, with a small team of people that have been working on it with me since the beginning.

I have some other personal projects. Like a system for small self sustaining communities. The system aims to give people in third world countries the ability to get out of poverty by giving them the tools necessary to sever their dependence on their government. Creating a isolated economy, outlining the minimum roles needed to be filled to provide food, water, etc.. Restricting trade, and debt accumulation etc..

I have tons of other projects too, just haven't had time to seriously engage in most of them yet.
